note: RGBA with keyed alpha. Faces are shared; each team has a front and a back torso print. Cells are [x, y, w, h] in pixels from the top-left; each has a 2 px edge-extended gutter.
rows_note: Colour rows that replace the prints below LOD1, per level (no-micro = LOD2, blocks = LOD3), role (att = attendant shirt, cap = captain) and side: [t0, t1, sRGB hex] from the bottom of the torso (t = 0) up; each row is the dominant colour of the print over the plastic.
